{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter to loyal customers
loyal_df = df[df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Compute the number of converted orders and total loyal customers
n_converted = loyal_df['converted'].sum()
n_loyal = len(loyal_df)
conversion_rate = n_converted / n_loyal

# Print the conversion rate as a float, which will be used in evidence
print(conversion_rate)"}
